conventions.units: metres in Blender/GLB; Unreal imports as centimetres
conventions.placements: p = plan metres (x east, y north; Unreal X = y*100, Y = x*100); theta = plan angle (deg CCW from east) of the asset's Blender +X; Unreal yaw = 90 - theta; z = 'ground' | 'water' | 'deck' | metres

austin.projection: local metres = ((lon - lon0) * 111320 cos(lat0), (lat - lat0) * 110574); plan = R(rot) local + offset (Scripts/mashup/build_mashup_data.py Proj + integrate_v2.py Frame.tf)
